title: Summit Mileage Transfer Fees and Limits
content:
Member-to-member transfers of award miles in the Crestline Summit Loyalty Program are charged to the sender and limited by the sender's tier as follows.

| Sender's tier | Transfer must be a whole multiple of (miles) | Smallest transfer (miles) | Fee per 1000 miles transferred (USD) | Processing fee per transfer (USD) | Most miles transferred out in one calendar year |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Summit Member | 1000 | 1000 | 12.5 | 30 | 100000 |
| Summit Silver | 1000 | 1000 | 12.5 | 30 | 100000 |
| Summit Gold | 1000 | 1000 | 10 | 30 | 100000 |
| Summit Platinum | 1000 | 1000 | 7.5 | 0 | 150000 |
| Summit Diamond | 1000 | 1000 | 0 | 0 | 200000 |
| Summit Chairman | 1000 | 1000 | 0 | 0 | 200000 |

**Worked figures on hypothetical transfers**

- A Summit Silver sender transferring 5000 miles: five thousands at 12.5 USD is 62.50 USD, plus the processing fee of 30 USD, a total of 92.50 USD.
- A Summit Gold sender transferring 5000 miles: five thousands at 10 USD is 50 USD, plus 30 USD, a total of 80 USD.
- A Summit Platinum sender transferring 5000 miles: five thousands at 7.5 USD is 37.50 USD, and no processing fee.
- A Summit Diamond or Summit Chairman sender pays nothing.

A transfer of 1500 miles is not a whole multiple of 1000 miles; 1000 and 2000 miles are.
